environment.description: AWS Lambda function triggered by IoT Core rule action. The Lambda execution role has s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, and s3:ListBucket permissions on the iot-device-telemetry-prod bucket. The Lambda runs in a private VPC subnet with no NAT gateway; S3 access is exclusively through a Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an endpoint policy. The VPC endpoint policy uses a Condition block with StringLike on s3:prefix matching '${aws:PrincipalTag/DeviceScope}/*' and the Lambda's IAM role has a session tag DeviceScope that is dynamically set via IoT Core rule action's roleArn with an AssumeRole session policy that injects the publishing device's thingName as the DeviceScope tag. The endpoint policy denies any s3:GetObject or s3:ListBucket request where the key prefix does not match the session-scoped device path.

config.lambda_role_policy: Allow s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:ListBucket on arn:aws:s3:::iot-device-telemetry-prod/*
config.network: Private subnet, no NAT, no internet gateway, S3 Gateway VPC Endpoint only
config.iot_rule_role: IoT Core rule uses AssumeRole with session tags, injecting thingName as DeviceScope principal tag
config.implicit_deny: VPC endpoint is the ONLY path to S3; no NAT/IGW means the endpoint policy is the sole access control plane
